One step that reads a device variable and stops the setup on a mismatch.

A number matches within ``tolerance``; a word matches exactly.

WaitStep.description:
One step that simply pauses for a number of seconds.

Use this to give hardware time to settle — for example waiting 3 seconds
after moving a shutter before checking that it arrived.

do.description: Step type. 'wait' pauses the plan for a fixed time.

description:
A named device state: the steps that put the machine in it, in order.

Each step is one of: ``set`` a device variable, ``wait`` some seconds,
``check`` a readback, or ``apply`` another setup. Steps run strictly in
order, top to bottom; a failed ``set`` or ``check`` stops the setup.

description.description: What this state is and when to use it.

steps.description: The steps to perform, in order from top to bottom.
steps.title: Steps
